parameters: Yeah! I heard about you, Narima.\! Glad to have you with us.
Well... I was born in Sayunaa, but adopted by Veridian parents after the Succession War!\! Really lucked out there...
Perhaps it was luck, perhaps the gods had better designs for your life, Jules.\! Tell me, have you been to our homeland since your adoption?
Sadly no... but I'd really like to some day!
...Please reconsider, or at least consult with me before setting foot in Sayunaa.
Wha.. why?\! I hear it is a wonderous place...

That it is, but we live in difficult times now.\! Our homeland is not what it once was.\! Jules... we Sayunaari must stick together in these times.\! Just promise you will consult me before doing anything rash...
....\| Sure thing, Narima.\! I appreciate having such a dedicated friend so soon after meeting!
The honor is mine, Jules.\! Donar be with you.
